What two web pages say: a short sourced note.

Read these two pages on the web and write `report/note.md` (at most one page of Markdown):

1. https://neurips.cc/Conferences/2026/CallForPapers — quote what it says about the page limit of a submission and the deadline for full papers.
2. https://www.example.com/ — quote its first paragraph.

For each page say how you read it and quote it exactly. If a page cannot be read, say so, with the exact error you got, instead of guessing its content.
